categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/code-signing-certificate.yml) and release maintenance tooling under contrib/devtools.
categories.rationale: Automates tracking of Windows signing certificate expiration and revocation to avoid release-blocking surprises during off-schedule or expedited point releases. As fanquake noted, certificates 'are constantly used to produce (point) releases, not just major releases, so always need to work'.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The tools category explicitly notes that 'Build and release scripts are build', and this script is dedicated to release CI monitoring.
